choices.text: [TODO:ko] (Aaron) Give in to keep the peace

aaron_yields.text:
[TODO:ko] Aaron gathers their rings and gold.
A fire is kindled in the camp.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] (In vision) See and grieve in spirit
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The Lord shows you their sin.

god_warns.text:
[TODO:ko] "Your people have corrupted themselves.
They worship a calf of gold."

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Let His anger consume them
[TODO:ko] Plead for Israel before the Lord
[TODO:ko] Ask Him to make a new nation of you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] His promise is not for you alone.

consume_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] A shepherd does not abandon the flock.
Lift your voice for them.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Plead for Israel before the Lord

self_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not for Your Name
self_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] His covenant is wider than you.
Pray for the people, not yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Plead for Israel before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] His anger relents at your words.

intercede.title: [TODO:ko] The Lord Relents
intercede.text:
[TODO:ko] His wrath turns from full ruin.
Now take the tablets and descend.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Carry the tablets down to the camp
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Two stones, written by His finger.

descent.title: [TODO:ko] Sound of a Strange Song
descent.text:
[TODO:ko] Joshua hears war in the camp.
"No," you say. "It is revelry."

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Pretend you did not hear it
[TODO:ko] Press on toward the noisy camp

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Face the Truth
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] A leader cannot turn away.
Go and see what they have done.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Press on toward the noisy camp

see_idol.text:
[TODO:ko] Firelight glints on a golden idol.
The people circle it in song.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Hide the tablets and walk on

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Throw the tablets down in holy wrath

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Join the circle to learn their hearts

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] His Word Demands Response
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] The covenant they broke must be seen.
Let the stones speak truth.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Throw the tablets down in holy wrath

join_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] No Compromise with Idols
join_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Light cannot dance with darkness.
Stand against, not among.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Throw the tablets down in holy wrath
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your steps turn toward the altar.

tablets_broken.title: [TODO:ko] Silence in the Camp
tablets_broken.text:
[TODO:ko] The dancing stops. Eyes drop low.
The calf still gleams on its altar.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Burn it, grind it, scatter the dust
[TODO:ko] Leave the calf as a warning
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] An idol left is an idol kept.

leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Idols must not be tolerated.
Destroy it without delay.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Burn it, grind it, scatter the dust

aaron_questioned.text:

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Shrug off the people's great sin
[TODO:ko] Call all who are for the Lord to you

shrug_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] A camp unjudged learns nothing.
Call the faithful to stand.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Call all who are for the Lord to you

single_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Aaron alone cannot bear this.
The whole camp must repent.

repentance.text:
[TODO:ko] The camp kneels in dust and tears.
The Lord still walks with His people.

ending.text:
[TODO:ko] The covenant bruised but not broken.
